final: WITH track_counts AS (SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(track_count) AS total_count FROM track_counts), shares AS (SELECT tc.TrackId, tc.track_count, CAST(tc.track_count AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS share FROM track_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT shares.track_count, shares.share, avg_share.mean_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE shares.share > avg_share.mean_share) SELECT AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - mean_share) AS average_excess_share FROM kept
